specific_knowledge.what: A dispense/SMT line read as compositions. Four objects: (1) a dispense deposit = a composition over its quality budget {volume, height, footprint, voids} -- a clog drifts the RATIOS while every single channel stays in spec (ratio-blind silent drift); (2) a placement = an exact 6-DOF pose (dual quaternion, SE(3)); a board of placements = a registration/deformation field; (3) a deposit geometry F=R*U = rotation(+)shape(+)size; (4) a cell = a health composition {placement_accuracy, thermal, feeder/nozzle, throughput}; a line = a composition of cells.
key_points: Planning anchor (measured): nozzle clog flagged in the log-ratios at deposit 47 vs single-channel volume alarm at deposit 67 = 20-deposit lead time, arrow correctly -> voids (dispense_drift.py, receipt cf9bf72f).

Contact-Point Doctrine (Peter's field law): the machine is dirty at every point of product contact; contamination radiates from those points; clean the highest-CONTACT points first; the machine already counts its own contacts (free contamination map). Rank maintenance by R_i = c_i (contacts) * d_i (log-ratio drift). Measured (contact_point_priority.py, ae19158b): R=c*d reaches the real nozzle clog FIRST while counts-only chases a busy-but-clean point and drift-only chases a high-drift-but-low-contact decoy. 'Nozzles, bingo.'

Coherence keystone (COHERENCE_AND_LASERS.md): Hs common-mode rejection IS source coherence. Law (measured, coherence_demo.py a5ceab9e): suppression_dB ~ -10*log10(1-rho) -- one extra '9' of coherence (0.9,0.99,0.999) = +10 dB; rho=1 -> numerical floor (~289 dB). A coherent laser makes the disturbance a TRUE common mode (identical on every channel) so closure+clr cancels it exactly; decoherence leaves only per-channel noise, nothing common to reject. Three locks: coherence makes the common mode common; Hs READS coherence back (1 - resid_var/total_var, recovers rho to 3-4 places) and GATES on it (refuse-to-guess); coherence also adds dimensions (coherent detection = amplitude+phase = dimension-is-the-message; direct detection is phase-blind). Same word twice for a reason.

Fiber-optic future (FUTURE_PROJECTS_FIBER_AND_Hs.md): fiber is two Hs ideas in glass -- a distributed FBG/WDM/DAS array is the skin of sensors (D channels = one composition); a fiber link is the neural pathway (power across modes = the message, dimension-is-the-message). Measured (fiber_hs_demo.py, e791ec63): closure+clr rejects shared multiplicative laser/thermal/connector common-mode to 5e-17 = 310 dB while raw read sits 13.6 dB BELOW the disturbance; additive detector noise honestly does NOT cancel. Fits the photonics-packaging future both domains are already entering (active fiber alignment 0.5-5um with optical feedback; UV-cure epoxy fiber bond). Verify on public data: PubDAS (DAS), PCB-AoI/SolDef_AI/PCB-SAID (inspection). T1 receipts + T2 mappings + T3 run-on-public-data; no vendor relationship implied.
